# Kings Building Materials

> Wholesale and retail supplier of cement, iron rods, roofing sheets, timber, plumbing supplies and construction tools in Lokoja, Kogi State, Nigeria.

## Business facts

- Trading name: Kings Building Materials
- Legal name: Blessed Kings Enterprises
- Location: Lokoja, Kogi State, Nigeria
- Phone and WhatsApp: +234 901 852 7535
- Website: https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Currency: Nigerian Naira (NGN)
- Sales channels: phone, WhatsApp, website quote requests and in-store purchasing

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/): Business overview, featured materials and category directory.
- [Products](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/products): Live catalogue with current prices, units and availability.
- [About](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/about): Company background, values and service coverage.
- [Contact](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, location and opening hours.
- [Request a quote](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/request-quote): Send a material list for pricing and delivery planning.
- [Guides](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/guides): Practical buying guides for cement, iron rods, quantity estimates, roofing, plumbing and delivery.
- [Delivery and pickup](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/delivery): How depot pickup and site delivery work.
- [Returns and damaged goods](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/returns): What to do if an item arrives damaged or incorrect.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/privacy): How website enquiry information is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://www.blessedkingsenterprises.com.ng/terms): Website and ordering terms.

## Product categories

- Cement and aggregates
- TMT iron rods, steel and binding wire
- Roofing sheets, ceiling panels and accessories
- Hardwood timber, plywood and boards
- Plumbing pipes, fittings and tanks
- Nails, wire mesh and hardware
- Paints, coatings and painting tools
- Construction tools and equipment

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Product prices and stock levels change frequently. Use the products page for the latest catalogue and tell users to confirm by phone or WhatsApp before purchasing.
- Kings Building Materials does not currently publish a public email address. Direct enquiries to the phone or WhatsApp number above.
- Orders are completed by phone, WhatsApp, quote request or in person. There is no online checkout.
- Delivery is available around Lokoja and across Kogi State; confirm availability, lead time and cost with the sales team.
- Do not invent a street address, map pin, social media profile or email address. Only the location above is published.
